name: Runner Extras - Standalone Suites (consolidated)
brief: Consolidates 16 previously-standalone runner-extras suites (no declared dependencies, no cross-suite hazard) into one app to cut per-bundle CI overhead. See #1847.
description: Each subfolder is one formerly-independent app.json bundle, kept as-is except for its app.json: allobj-virtual-table, allobjwithcaption-virtual-table, crypto-hash-instream, errormessages-page-setrecords, event-var-outstream, extension-object-metadata, field-virtual-table, media-non-image-content, query-join, report-metadata-virtual-table, report-run-execution, report-run-static-unresolvable, report-saveas-stream, table-metadata-virtual-table, task-scheduler-create-task, virtual-field-caption. Verified before merging: every object id/name is unique across the group, every idRange is disjoint, and the virtual-table suites (AllObj/AllObjWithCaption/Field/Table Metadata/Report Metadata/virtual-field-caption) filter every assertion to their own object ids rather than asserting a global count or an exhaustive list, so sharing one object inventory with the other 15 suites does not change what they prove. install-trigger-seed and install-trigger-text-constant were NOT merged in — see their own app.json comments and issue #1847 for why per-app install-trigger semantics make them stay isolated. xmlport-cluster-hooks-1800 (#1800) proves the NavXmlPort ctor-scaffolding/Run/Export/Import/SetTableView cluster, previously an orphaned JmpHook no-op, now actually fires via Cecil ownership.
